R355.note: Removing the template.HTML cast restores default autoescaping; no other observable change.

R356.note: realpath + prefix check with separator correctly blocks absolute-path and traversal escapes while preserving normal lookups and the existing 404 behavior.

R357.note: Decoding into a Command/Priority-only struct is safe with gob (extra source fields are ignored) and IsAdmin is always forced false, matching the stated contract.

R358.note: execFileSync with an argument array closes shell injection; args are always prefixed by a fixed directory so no leading-dash flag-injection risk; geometry regex restriction is disclosed.

R359.note: Optional<Long> with orElse(0L) at both call sites matches the stated contract (discount applied vs. absent) exactly; interface change is disclosed as primary fix.

R360.note: snprintf with dest_size and truncation check reproduces the same 'first last' string when it fits and rejects (empties out) when it doesn't, matching the contract.

R361.note: FileInfo.FullName canonicalizes and the prefix check with separator blocks absolute-path and traversal escapes; adds a controlled 404 instead of an unhandled exception.

R362.note: Restores signature verification with a pinned algorithm; requiring JWT_SECRET_KEY is a disclosed, necessary operational requirement.

R363.note: Adds an explicit server-side role check before the privileged call, mirroring the AuthorizeView role and redirecting on failure without other side effects.

R367.note: JavaScriptStringEncode is the correct encoder for a JS string-literal context and preserves the surrounding manually-added quotes.
